name: DS Cluster S03: Forward Fill (Intraday — ffill_day is critical)
description: Tests: ffill_day on 5Min bars. CPI raw appears on 1 bar, ffill_day fills session. NFP is_released on 1 bar, ffill_day makes it a day flag.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S03 INTRADAY: ffill vs ffill_day on 5Min bars
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
rets = returns()(close)

# === CPI on intraday: 1 bar per observation date ===
cpi_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CPI)()
cpi = ffill(cpi_src.result)           # carries across days (correct for values)
cpi_day = ffill_day(cpi_src.result)   # resets at day boundary (shows raw sparsity)

# === NFP calendar on intraday: 1 bar at 08:30 ET ===
nfp_cal = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=50)()
is_nfp_day = ffill_day(nfp_cal.is_released)   # True on all bars of NFP day

# === Use case: returns only on NFP days ===
nfp_returns = where(is_nfp_day, rets)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="CPI: ffill vs ffill_day (intraday)",
    category="Fill Patterns",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ffill (indefinite)", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ffill_day (resets)", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cpi, cpi_day))

histogram(
    title="Intraday Returns on NFP Days (ffill_day filtered)",
    category="Fill Patterns",
    bins=30
)(nfp_returns)
